# Vendored dependencies

`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the unmodified SheetJS Community Edition release from
https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz (Apache-2.0; license included
inside the archive and installed package).

The upstream npm registry version is outdated. Official installation guidance
recommends vendoring for dependable builds:
https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/ .
